Prototype 8 encodes N3 (100% pure) primarily through EEG (95%), with EOG (4%) and EMG (2%) contribution.
Its EEG signature shows elevated δ (+7.7 dB, sensitivity=17.7) and absence of β_h (-0.3 dB, sensitivity=2.1).
The δ activity is present in 83% of each epoch (sustained), with moderate eye movements (SEM 52% active (likely EEG crosstalk)) and atonic muscle tone.
This is coherent with N3 physiology: δ elevated, δ dominant, EMG atonic — all confirmed.
